name: Ishpan
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Ishpan was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob (Israel). He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles and Genesis as part of the tribe of Asher, one of the twelve tribes of Israel. His significance lies in his role as a patriarch within the lineage of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Asher
keyEvents.description: Ishpan is mentioned as one of the sons of Asher, son of Jacob and Zilpah, in Jacob's genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in the lineage of Asher
keyEvents.description: Ishpan is listed among the sons of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jishpan is listed in the detailed genealogies of 1 Chronicles as part of the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Asher counted in the wilderness
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Jishpan belonged, was numbered during the census in the wilderness after leaving Egypt.
